name: app-bar
title: App Bar
description: Responsive caller-owned workbench items, launcher, and actions.

.caps-app-bar-section + .caps-app-bar-se.borderTop:
var(--border) solid
      color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content) 14%, transparent)

.caps-app-bar .caps-app-bar-launcher-but.boxShadow:
inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / calc(var(--depth) * 0.1)),
      inset 0 -2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / calc(var(--depth) * 0.16)),
      0 3px 7px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / calc(var(--depth) * 0.35))

.caps-app-bar-launchers::before.borderTop:
var(--border) solid
      color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content) 14%, transparent)
.caps-app-bar-launchers::before.borderLeft:
var(--border) solid
      color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content) 14%, transparent)
